    Developer Guidelines

    In order to contribute to PowerGraphics.jl repository please read the following sections of InfrastructureSystems.jl and SiennaTemplate.jl documentation in detail:

    1. Style Guide
    2. Documentation Best Practices
    3. Contributing Guidelines

    Pull requests are always welcome to fix bugs or add additional modeling capabilities.

    All the code contributions need to include tests with a minimum coverage of 70%
